description: rimu-ws - a fork of wtx on a thread-per-core io_uring executor (multishot accept and recv into a provided buffer ring). HTTP/1.1 through its Http1ServerFramework: a hand-written resumable request parser and body decoder (Content-Length and chunked) that answer straight out of the receive buffer, a path router with one handler per method, a server-header middleware, and the query parsed on every request. No spin: the runtimes sleep as soon as the ring is empty.
